fact: In February 2024 Airtel RDC and UNICEF reported routers and outdoor units installed in 20 target secondary schools (10 Kinshasa, 10 Haut-Katanga) to connect 10,000 pupils, against MICS 2018 figures of 0.4% of secondary schools with computers.
title: Engagement à soutenir l'apprentissage numérique en République Démocratique du Congo
